name: DSH-DREAM
description: Persistent long-term memory for LLM agents with a DSH-native settings panel.

enable_memory.title: Enable long-term memory
enable_memory.description: Turn Chroma-backed memory retrieval on or off. When off, memory_search returns an empty result without opening Chroma.

enable_auto_recall.title: Auto-recall before each turn
enable_auto_recall.description: Inject a small optional memory hint before the first model step when a highly relevant memory exists. Disable to skip automatic retrieval while keeping memory_search available.

rag_path.title: Vector database path
rag_path.description: Leave blank to use the DSH user directory; enter an absolute path to customize, or set AGENT_MEMORY_RAG_PATH to override.

python_path.title: Python interpreter path
python_path.description: Optional absolute path to a Python with chromadb and sentence-transformers; leave blank to auto-detect an adjacent .venv or PATH.

hf_home_path.title: Model cache directory
hf_home_path.description: Optional writable directory for Hugging Face models; leave blank to try the DSH profile, plugin, and working-directory .hf-cache locations.

max_window_tokens.title: Window token budget
max_window_tokens.description: Token budget used to initialize WindowManager.

retrieval_top_k.title: Retrieval top-k
retrieval_top_k.description: Number of RAG memories returned by memory_search.

embedding_provider.title: Embedding provider
embedding_provider.description: local uses the bundled Chinese model; openai_compatible calls a cloud /embeddings API.

embedding_model.title: Embedding model
embedding_model.description: Cloud model name. Leave blank for the local BAAI model or the cloud default text-embedding-3-small.

embedding_api_key.title: Embedding API key
embedding_api_key.description: Bearer token for the cloud embedding endpoint. Stored in the local bridge config; shown masked in the panel.

embedding_base_url.title: Embedding base URL
embedding_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, for example https://api.deepseek.com/v1 (confirm it matches your API key).

auto_rebuild_collection.title: Re-embed old data on dimension mismatch
auto_rebuild_collection.description: Try to re-embed old records into the new vector dimension. Cloud embedding APIs may consume tokens.

holographic_mode.title: Holographic mode (force full memory)
holographic_mode.description: When enabled, every completed turn writes the complete User and Assistant originals to the vector store, regardless of whether the agent called a tool.

router_enabled.title: RouterEngine (auto routing)
router_enabled.description: Decide before retrieval whether the turn needs long-term memory. Off restores the exact pre-v0.4.0 behaviour.

router_mode.title: Router mode
router_mode.description: auto prefers cloud then local then regex; cloud/local/regex narrow the preference.

router_budget_ms.title: Router budget (ms)
router_budget_ms.description: Hard deadline for the routing decision. Capped at 200 ms; ambiguity and timeouts default to retrieve.

router_threshold.title: Router threshold
router_threshold.description: Probability threshold for the cloud and regex layers.

router_uncertainty_band.title: Uncertainty band
router_uncertainty_band.description: Inside this band the router abstains and still retrieves (better to over-retrieve than to forget).

router_timeout_policy.title: Timeout policy
router_timeout_policy.description: Decision when the 200 ms budget expires: retrieve (neutral default) or bypass_main.

router_shadow_mode.title: Router shadow mode
router_shadow_mode.description: Always retrieve like the legacy path, but log what RouterEngine would have decided.

router_cloud_enabled.title: Use a cloud decision model
router_cloud_enabled.description: Off by default. When enabled, the query text is sent to the configured decision provider.

router_cloud_provider.title: Cloud provider
router_cloud_provider.description: Preset id: typesafe, ali-bailian, tokenrhythm, openai, local-laya, or custom.

router_cloud_base_url.title: Cloud endpoint base URL
router_cloud_base_url.description: Base URL of the decision endpoint; workspace-level for ali-bailian.

router_cloud_model.title: Cloud decision model
router_cloud_model.description: Model name for the active provider.

router_cloud_api_key_env.title: Cloud credential env var
router_cloud_api_key_env.description: Environment variable holding the provider key. The key itself is never stored in the bridge file.

router_local_backend.title: Local router backend
router_local_backend.description: bge-head reuses the local BGE encoder (default), onnx-intent is optional, off disables the local layer.
